name: App Icon: 2D Straw Hat Ronin Stance
purpose: Primary 2D App Store Icon — Wandering Straw-Hat Ronin.
description: Pure flat 2D solid black silhouette of a wandering ronin in traditional conical straw kasa hat in combat-ready posture with katana blade, centered before a massive blood-red circular sun.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. (Pure flat solid black silhouette of a ronin samurai warrior wearing a wide conical straw kasa hat:1.3) holding a sharp katana blade in battle stance. (Directly framed inside a giant perfectly smooth solid crimson-red circular sun:1.4). Pure flat 2D vector illustration, solid pitch-black figure (#07080C), deep crimson red (#D20A2E), pristine razor-sharp clean edges, flat graphic shapes, high contrast, no 3D rendering, no soft painting, no gradients, no realistic face, no text, no typography, no pixelation, no noise.
